draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for your question about API rate limits earlier — glad Tariq could confirm that limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter. Your ticket on that is closed, so just say the word if anything there is still open.

On setup: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you.

Best,
Priya
